name: The Fall of Kel'Thuzad
label: Quest
description: The Fall of Kel'Thuzad: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The phylactery is all that remains of the master of Naxxramas. Your better judgment dictates that you destroy the phylactery, preventing the lich from ever reforming. Thankfully, you seldom listen to that internal voice of reason.
Someone at Light's Hope will pay you hugely for this artifact. Who cares if Kel'Thuzad regenerates to full power?
